venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be emailed once registration closes

items.information:
This competition is on a **Friday evening** and will only feature the 3x3 Fewest Moves event. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
